specs.label: AxLink Port
specs.value: (1) 4-position 3.5mm Screw Terminal, provides data and power to external AxLink control devices

specs.label: AxLink Indicator
specs.value: (1) AxLink LED (green) indicates the state of the AxLink port

specs.label: RS-232/422/485 Ports
specs.value: (1) 10-position 3.5mm Screw Terminal, NetLinx Port 1, XON/XOFF (transmit on / transmit off), CTS/RTS (clear to send/ready to send), 300 - 115,200 baud

specs.label: RS-232 Port
specs.value: (1) 5-position 3.5mm Screw Terminal, NetLinx Port 2, XON/XOFF (transmit on / transmit off), CTS/RTS (clear to send/ready to send), 300 - 115,200 baud

specs.label: Serial Indicator
specs.value: (2) sets of LEDs (red/yellow) indicate when serial Ports 1 and 2 are transmitting and receiving data

specs.label: IR/Serial Indicators
specs.value: (2) LEDs (red) indicate when each of the IR/Serial ports (11-12) are transmitting control data

specs.label: I/O Indicator
specs.value: (4) LEDs (yellow) indicate each of the I/O channels (1-4) are active

specs.label: IR/RX Indicator
specs.value: (1) IR RX LED (red) LED lights when IR data is being received via the IR/RX port
